verdict.rationale: Together AI publishes an OpenAPI 3.1 document (openapi.yaml, listed in llms.txt) and a per-endpoint API reference generated from it, such as the chat-completions reference. That establishes a structured, spec-driven API reference. The probe's 404s on openapi.json and swagger.json paths do not contradict this, since the spec is served as YAML. However, nothing in the evidence shows the reference is interactive (a try-it console) or includes runnable examples. missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it/playground in the reference, runnable code examples per endpoint, independent or hands-on corroboration.
